faq_heading: Homes near Queen Elizabeth Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Queen Elizabeth Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Queen Elizabeth Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Queen Elizabeth Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Queen Elizabeth Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 501 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,180,000, townhomes $636,500, condos $414,900. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Queen Elizabeth Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Queen Elizabeth Secondary the median was 29 days on the market, closing at 96.7% of the list price, with 8% of sales above the list price for the 501 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Queen Elizabeth Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are A H P Matthew Elementary (0.7 km north-west), Creekside Elementary (0.9 km south-east) and Simon Cunningham Elementary (0.9 km east).

Queen Elizabeth Secondary is a secondary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 9457 King George Blvd. It teaches grades 8 to 12. Programs listed: Inter-A (8-12).
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Queen Elizabeth Secondary, followed by what homes within 2 km of the school sold for.
How the Queen Elizabeth Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Queen Elizabeth Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Queen Elizabeth Secondary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 501 homes sold within 2 km of Queen Elizabeth Secondary: 77 houses, 44 townhomes and 373 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $414,900.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Queen Elizabeth Secondary

32 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Queen Elizabeth Secondary in a straight line (20 elementary, 10 secondary, 2 other; 3 independent). The closest is A H P Matthew Elementary, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Prince Charles Elementary, 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is North Surrey Learning Centre (1.0 km); the nearest independent school is Honour Secondary School (2.0 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Simon Cunningham Elementary (0.9 km). Other secondary schools close by: North Surrey Learning Centre (1.0 km east), SD 36 Alternate North Surrey LC (1.0 km east), SAIL Secondary (1.1 km south-east), SD 36 Education Services (Type 1) (1.1 km south-east), Surrey Academy of Innovative Learning (1.1 km south-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Surrey Academy of Innovative Learning, 1.1 km south-east of Queen Elizabeth Secondary.
